what_happened: Localized the hotspot in one profiled run plus three #count_heartbeats A/B probes: cumulative simp is 14988s of the module's ~15100s total elaboration (1348 simp calls above 200ms, median 5.55s), while unfold/split is only ~108s. Replacing 'unfold applyRule + repeat split + all_goals simp_all only' with the already-generated per-arm equation lemmas applyRule.eq_1..eq_37 cut applyRule_andPos_closed from 882487 to 760 heartbeats (1161x), applyRule_serialityRule_closed from 2084589 to 146 (14278x), applyRule_boxNeg_closed from 885047 to 27178 (32.6x).

The module's own inline comments misattribute the cost: 36 copies of '-- unfold applyRule reduces the 36-arm match to this rule's arm: about 0.9M heartbeats measured' and the NonAnalytic section note blaming whnf arm-position. The 0.9M heartbeat figure is accurate for the whole declaration but the profiler shows the cost is the all_goals simp_all cascade, not unfold/split. These comments must be rewritten, not preserved, or they will steer the next reader wrong.

Research report carried three verified A/B heartbeat probes (andPos 882487->760, serialityRule 2084589->146, boxNeg 885047->27178) spanning all three proof-body shapes, plus compiling scripts. Planning needed zero approach exploration: phases decompose by the module's five existing sections against an already-proven remedy.

plan-format.md requires a '## Lean Challenge Statements' section for every lean4 plan with the Challenge identifier set equal to the Goals identifier set, but this task proves no new statement (36 pre-existing theorems preserved byte-identical; the 37 new wrappers have generator-produced right-hand sides not determinable at plan time). Resolved by declaring an explicitly empty identifier set on both sides with an in-section rationale; statement fidelity is enforced instead by per-phase unchanged-signature checks and a 74-declaration axiom-profile diff in the final phase.

lake-build-guard REPLAYed a stale green result: a source file (Tableau.lean, comment fix) was edited while a guarded full build was running; the guard's post_fingerprint was taken after the edit, so the next guarded build matched it and replayed exit 0 although Tableau.olean was older than its source. Caught by the olean-newer-than-source check; rerun with --no-share.

Plan did not anticipate that the converted proofs are longer than the cascade scripts: Tableau.lean (+146 lines) and SubformulaProperty.lean (+~190 lines) both crossed their linter.style.longFile limits, needing a baseline bump / new baseline.

Inserting 146 lines into Tableau.lean shifted six file.lean:NNN citations in five other modules; check-module-invariants C20 (declaration span) failed on one of them. Repaired with scripts/reanchor-lean-citations.py --exact (plus two range ends by hand, which the tool leaves stale), at the cost of a second Tableau rebuild. Running the --no-build invariants pass right after Phase 2 would have caught it one full build earlier.
